machines.name: Research Station2
machines.description: Consumes 0.5 units per second of any solid item. Research cap depends entirely on the number of active Research Station2s, while research speed is determined by the item's research value (found in its recipe book entry). It's recommended to monitor your current research statistics using the Research Tracking Panel.

machines.name: Research Station3
machines.description: Requires two different Items to operate, consuming 0.1 units per second from each node. Research speed is determined by the item's research value (found in the Recipe Book), while research cap is based on the item's sell value. Make sure to use the Research Tracking Panel for exact statistics. Experimentation is recommended!

machines.name: Research Station4
machines.description: Does not conduct research on its own. Must be placed next to the 'fuller' side of a Research Station 3 to form a combined structure. When connected, it increases power consumption to 5 MMF/s and raises the research cap. Completing the logic minigame increase the cap even further Logic minigame: Gives out 4 bit number output each cycle, your job is to add this current 4 bit number with the last's cycle 4 bit number and correctly input into the 5 bit input. You must then lock in the answer by powering the confirmed input (will move to the next cycle too). If it is correct, the 'last cycle was correct' logic output will get a pulse.

machines.name: Research Tracking Panel
machines.description: Helps track metrics related to research. Useful at any stage of the game, as it helps see how fast your research progress is going and when it will start to gradually slow down (research efficiency threshold or also known as the research soft cap). Up until you reach the efficiency threshold, you will gain research at a constant speed. Afterwards, you will gain less and less research points.

machines.name: Satellite Dish
machines.description: Consumes 75kMF/s to operate. Needs to be paired with a Satellite Dish Controller to do anything meaningful! Powerful piece of scientific radar. Able to scream into and receive from the void we call space. Combine this with some Satellite Dish Controllers to get a bonus on your Research Points production (RP/s)! More info can be seen at the Research Tracking Panel.

machines.name: Satellite Dish Controller
machines.description: Similiar to the Research Station 2, but designed to use fluids (0.5L/s). Unlike the Research Station 2, it provides a Research Speed (RP/s) multiplier. This means it acts as an addon to existing research station, boosting their progress speed. The fluid research multiplier is important and can be checked in the recipe menu. Requires Satellite Dishes to operate (can be placed anywhere in the world). More controllers increase overall research speed. Depending on the fluid used, you will need a different number of Satellite Dishes to match it. Satellite Dishes can be placed anywhere in the world. More details can be found in the Research Tracking Panel!

machines.name: Steam Condenser
machines.description: Condenses Low Pressure Steam into Condensate, which can be refined back into Distilled Water. Functions similarly to a boiler, except it cools instead of heating. Can be connected to the powerplant using the data node and data cable. Hot water can be cooled down in a Cooling Tower. Condensate can be cleaned back into Distilled Water in a Polisher, to be used in the Heat Exchanger again.

machines.name: Steam Cracking Plant
machines.description:
Converts crude oil into more usable chemicals for plastic production.

Higher steam temperature equals faster work (up to tenfold).

machines.name: Steam Turbine
machines.description:
Converts hot steam into power. Uses 3 Steam/s and produces 0.1 Water/s

(We strongly recommend that you use LargeTurbine instead, as it has a far higher power yield). Operates even when full on water

Outputs a signal depending on the settings.

machines.name: Tree
machines.description:
To grow trees, a sprinkler is required to be within range.

Harvesting must take place within the range of a FarmHarvester.

(Trees develop more slowly in place with heavy pollution, and in areas starting with -60% pollution).

machines.name: Tree Farm Controller
machines.description:
Main controller and power of a tree farm.

All parts need to be in range for them to work

(only one is needed per FARM! Multiples in the same range will break each other!)

(Parts of the modular farm aren't required to connect nicely).

machines.name: Tree Farm Output
machines.description:
Outputs harvested materials.

Needs to be in range of a FarmHarvester.

machines.name: Tree Farm Sprinkler
machines.description:
Allow trees to grow.

Requires a water tank to be in range of a TreeFarmController.

machines.name: Tree Farm Water Tank
machines.description:
Gives sprinklers water.

(Regardless of the tank's volume, one tank is required for every three sprinklers.)

machines.name: Turbine Generator
machines.description: Head of the modular turbine. Goes right after Low Pressure Turbines. Generates power and is the controller of the turbine, connects to powerplants (via Data Cable) to be controlled.

machines.name: Turbine Input
machines.description: The first component inside a modular turbine. After it follows several High Pressure Turbines.

machines.name: Turbine Output
machines.description: Connects to the Turbine Generator and is the final piece in a modular turbine. A modular turbine layout may look like this: Input -> High Pressure Turbines -> Intermediate Pressure Turbine -> Low Pressure Turbines -> Generator -> Output. Output for the low pressure steam after turbine used it.

machines.name: Underground Waste Facility
machines.description: Requires 140 Concrete Blocks and 70 Lead Ingots to store 7000 of any liquid or item. Stored materials do not emit radiation nor pollution and are effectively neutralized and lost to time. Requires some time to reach 100% maintenance, which can be checked at the display monitor.
